#include <IRsend.h>

// Frequency for Carrier is usually 38kHz
const uint16_t kFrequency = 38;

void setup() {
  irsend.begin();
  Serial.begin(115200);
  Serial.println("Carrier AC Controller Ready. Type 'ON' or 'OFF'.");
}

void loop() {
  if (Serial.available()) {
    String command = Serial.readStringUntil('\n');
    command.trim();
    command.toUpperCase();

    if (command == "ON") {
      Serial.println("Replaying ON Signal...");
      irsend.sendRaw(rawOn, 295, kFrequency);
    } 
    else if (command == "OFF") {
      Serial.println("Replaying OFF Signal...");
      irsend.sendRaw(rawOff, 295, kFrequency);
    }
  }
}
